messages.subject: Prediction intervals in unmarked
parts:
Dear list members,

Is there a way to get a narrower prediction interval for fitted occupancy models? I usually got to wider prediction intervals with the function "predict".

Is it possible to get confidence interval instead of prediction intervals?  Should I plot confidence intervals instead of prediction intervals.

Best,

Manuel

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Prediction intervals in unmarked
parts:
Hi Manuel, Marc Mazerolle's AICcmodavg package works great for calculating CIs for models fit with unmarked functions:

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/AICcmodavg/index.html

Matt
